title: Invoice processing automation: what it does and how to test it
description: How software reads supplier invoices and feeds accounts payable, which public datasets measure it, and how to test it on your own invoices.
summary: Invoice processing automation reads each supplier invoice, pulls out the vendor, date, line items and total, and sends the result to your accounting system. A person only reviews the invoices the software is unsure about.

example.input: A scanned supplier invoice with 12 line items, a purchase order number and a tax line.
example.output: Vendor name, invoice number, due date, each line item and the total, matched to the purchase order, with any mismatch flagged for a person.

howToTest: Collect 100 past invoices from your real suppliers, including bad scans and unusual layouts, and write down the correct fields by hand.
Run each tool on the same 100 invoices and count the fields it got exactly right, field by field.
Count the invoices it sent through with a wrong total or wrong vendor. These errors cost the most.
Check that low-confidence invoices go to a person instead of straight to payment.
Compare the cost and time per invoice, including the time your staff spend fixing errors.

buyVsBuild.buy: Buy when your invoices come from many suppliers in many layouts and you want it working this quarter.
buyVsBuild.build: Build when you receive very high volumes of a few fixed layouts, or when you need tight control over where the documents go.

watchOuts: A tool that is right on clean sample invoices can still fail on your worst scans. Test on your own mess.
Public benchmarks such as receipts datasets are not invoices, so their scores do not predict your results.
Keep a human approval step before money moves, at least for large or new-vendor invoices.
Keep the original invoice file. The IRS says records that support a deduction must be kept until the period of limitations for that return runs out.

resources.name: CORD: Consolidated Receipt Dataset
resources.what: A public dataset of Indonesian receipt images with labels, used to test systems that read documents. It is receipts, not invoices.

resources.name: Key information extraction survey (ACM Computing Surveys)
resources.what: A 2025 literature review of deep learning methods that pull key fields from business documents.

sources.name: IRS: How long should I keep records?
sources.what: States that records supporting income, deductions or credits must be kept until the period of limitations for the return runs out.

sources.name: Key information extraction survey (ACM Computing Surveys)
sources.what: Describes extracting key information from business documents as a large share of business workloads and a target for automation.
